actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, strongly significant RNA and CNV identity evidence (metabolic/immune pathway shifts, coordinated 3p tumor-suppressor locus differences, CDKN2A/PTEN loss, 12p/20q gains), no technical confounder association, and cross-modal membership supported by a median of 3 of 4 modalities with a directionally positive boundary against C0002. Internal fused separation is weak and resampling stability modest, so uncertainty remains, but no available request could resolve this and no better-supported structural revision is indicated; retain for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent RNA/CNV profile that is the directional mirror of C0001 with comparable effect magnitudes, no technical confounder association, cross-modal membership supported by a median of 3 of 4 modalities with all four modalities positive, and relatively stable internal resampling (ARI 0.784). Boundary separation from C0001 is small, so uncertainty remains, but no available request could resolve this and no better-supported structural revision is indicated; retain for downstream validation.
